scripts.text:
[Mungmung]
I'm not the innkeeper!
Why do people want to pay me when they see me?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我不是旅店老板！
为什么一看到我，大家就想付钱给我？

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
My pain is getting worse and worse
since the crevice appeared in Bifrost.
Are you responsible for it, young one?
scripts.translation:
[内姆内姆]
自从双层牛肉堡出现裂缝以来，
我的痛苦越来越严重了。
是你造成的吗，年轻人？

scripts.text: Of course I am!
scripts.translation: 当然是我！

scripts.text: That's an unfair accusation!
scripts.translation: 这真是无稽之谈！

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
Bra~vo!
scripts.translation:
[内姆内姆]
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
If not, never mind!
scripts.translation:
[内姆内姆]
如果不是，那就当我没说！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
So the situation
was at its worst.
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
所以当时的情况
已经糟糕到了极点。

scripts.text:
[Raffles]
Oh~!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔斯]
噢~！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
Bored to death, I started to cry.
Then I fell asleep, tired from all the crying.
And when I woke up,
I was even more bored
than before!
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
我无聊得要死，于是开始哭泣。
然后因为哭得太累，我就睡着了。
等我醒来时，
我比之前更无聊了！

scripts.text:
[Raffles]
Oh, oh!
That's terrible, so terrible.
How could that happen?!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔斯]
噢，噢！
太可怕了，太可怕了。
怎么会发生这种事？！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
So the situation got
more and more serious...
Now give me some more coins.
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
所以情况变得
越来越严重了...
现在再给我一些硬币吧。

scripts.text:
[Rangrang]
I've never heard such a boring and sad story.
I feel like crying!
scripts.translation:
[朗朗]
我从未听过如此无聊又悲伤的故事。
我都想哭了！

scripts.text:
[A Decoy]
Oh~!
That's just so
unbelievable!
I'm so curious, let's give him some coins!
scripts.translation:
[诱饵]
噢~！
这简直太不可思议了！
我很好奇，我们给他一些硬币吧！

scripts.text:
[Moved Raffle]
This is sad, too sad!
I'm not sure why,
but it must be sad
because everybody else says so.
scripts.translation:
[感动的 拉弗尔]
这太悲伤了，太悲伤了！
我不确定为什么，
但既然大家都这么说，
那它一定很悲伤。

scripts.text:
[Relieved Raffle]
Wow~!
This is exciting.
He woke up safe and sound again!
Well, I'm sure he will next time!
...
scripts.translation:
[松了口气的 拉弗尔]
哇~！
这真令人兴奋。
他又安全地醒来了！
嗯，我相信下次也会如此！
...

scripts.text:
[Relieved Raffle]
Eh?
scripts.translation:
[松了口气的 拉弗尔]
咦？

scripts.text:
[Excited Raffle]
Wow~
The story is no fun at all.
Wow~!
But it's as if we were singing in chorus -
it's really fun.
Wow~!
scripts.translation:
[兴奋的 拉弗尔]
哇~
这个故事一点都不有趣。
哇~！
但就像我们在合唱一样——
真的很有趣。
哇~！

scripts.text:
[Impressed Raffle]
Wow! Wow!
scripts.translation:
[佩服的 拉弗尔]
哇！哇！

scripts.text:
[Visitor to Mora]
I'm stuck here because of the crevice, which appeared out of nowhere.
Ha......
scripts.translation:
[莫拉的访客]
因为突然出现的裂缝，我被困在这里了。
哈......

scripts.text:
[Visitor to Mora]
Isn't this one cheerful village?
With Bifrost blocked like that, I'm thinking of settling here permanently.
scripts.translation:
[莫拉的访客]
这不是一个很快乐的村庄吗？
既然双层牛肉堡被堵住了，我正考虑在这里定居下来。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I heard that somebody made it out of the Labyrinth Forest alive.
Whoever it is, I want to meet this person myself.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我听说有人活着走出了迷宫森林。
不管是谁，我都想亲自见见这个人。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
I'll come out of the Labyrinth Forest and become a hero!
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
我要走出迷宫森林，成为英雄！

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
I hear somebody already did that.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
我听说已经有人做到了。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
What if I say I'm that somebody?
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
如果我说那个人就是我呢？

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
Forget it. It's more believable
to say I did it.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
别开玩笑了。说我自己做到的还更可信一点。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
Well, that's true.
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
嗯，确实是这样。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
I'll come out of the Labyrinth Forest and become a hero!
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
我要走出迷宫森林，成为英雄！

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
I hear somebody already did that.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
我听说已经有人做到了。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
What if I say I'm that somebody?
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
如果我说那个人就是我呢？

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
Forget it. It's more believable
to say I did it.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
别开玩笑了。说我自己做到的还更可信一点。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
Well, that's true.
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
嗯，确实是这样。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Stay clear of the Labyrinth Forest.
Don't ever dream of peeking in out of curiosity.
Lots of travelers have gone missing after going there.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
离迷宫森林远一点。
千万别因为好奇就想去窥探。
很多旅行者进去之后就失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
The public bath in the center of the village is a symbol of Mora Village.
scripts.translation:
[悠闲的大王花]
村庄中心的公共浴池是穆拉村的象征。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
It's not just a simple puddle.
It has tremendous power
to heal wounds.
scripts.translation:
[悠闲的大王花]
它不仅仅是一滩水。
它具有强大的治愈伤口的力量。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
Try walking in the bath
if you want to see for yourself.
It will slowly but surely heal your wounds.
scripts.translation:
[悠闲的大王花]
如果你想亲眼见证，不妨走进浴池试试。
它会缓慢但确定地治愈你的伤口。

scripts.text:
[Shortffle]
I want to climb the ladder,
but my legs are too short to do that.
scripts.translation:
[矮拉弗尔]
我想爬梯子，
但我的腿太短，爬不上去。

scripts.text:
[Shortffle]
I wonder who brought it here.
scripts.translation:
[矮拉弗尔]
不知道是谁把它搬到这里来的。

scripts.text:
You see a Rafflesia
lost in reading.
scripts.translation:
你看到一朵草精
正沉浸在阅读中。

scripts.text: See what he's reading.
scripts.translation: 看看他在读什么

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 别管他

scripts.text:
Curious about what he's reading,
you quietly approach him from behind.
The Rafflesia is reading in a low voice.
scripts.translation:
出于好奇，你悄悄从背后靠近他。
草精正低声朗读着。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren was going to Eremes's.
He was going there to borrow
Eremes's reference books,
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
塞蕾恩要去埃雷梅斯那里。
他去那里是为了借阅
埃雷梅斯的参考书，

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
but he also hoped to see
his beautiful sister, Seiren.
Seiren knocked on Eremes's door
with his heart pounding.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
但他也希望见到
他美丽的姐姐，塞蕾恩。
塞蕾恩心跳加速地
敲响了埃雷梅斯的门。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Knock! Knock! Knock!
Excuse me. Is anybody there?
... ... ...
He doesn't hear anything.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
咚！咚！咚！
打扰了。有人在家吗？
... ... ...
他什么也没听到。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Is there nobody home?
He knocked again,
afraid that he might have
made the trip for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
难道没人吗？
他又敲了一次，
担心自己白跑一趟。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Knock! Knock! Knock!
No answer again. Is there nobody home?
He knew it was rude to do that,
but he decided to enter anyway
and wait for Eremes to come back home.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
咚！咚！咚！
还是没人应声。难道没人吗？
他知道这样做很无礼，
但他还是决定进去，
等埃雷梅斯回来。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren opened the front door
with his heart throbbing.
*squeak*
The door wasn't locked.
Eremes seems to be away for a while.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
塞蕾恩心跳加速地打开了前门。
*吱呀*
门没有锁。
看来埃雷梅斯暂时不在家。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren entered the house hesitantly.
The moment he stepped into the house,
he heard a sound of water running.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
塞蕾恩犹豫地走进了屋子。
刚踏进屋内，
他就听到了流水声。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren suddenly came to his senses,
and turned back to go out.
But right at the moment!!
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
塞蕾恩突然回过神来，
转身准备离开。
但就在那一瞬间！！

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
*thud*
The bathroom door opened,
and with white steam pouring out came a foot.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
*砰*
浴室的门开了，
伴随着喷涌而出的白色蒸汽，
伸出了一只脚。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren's heart almost stopped
at the sight of it. And a moment later,
somebody came out from the bathroom,
with just a towel around her body.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
看到这一幕，塞蕾恩的心脏几乎停跳。
片刻之后，
一个人从浴室里走了出来，
身上只围着一条毛巾。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
With her body still wet
from the shower...
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
她的身体还湿漉漉的，
显然刚洗完澡...

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
*gasp* Who are you? How long
were you standing there? How rude.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
*倒吸凉气* 你是谁？
你在那里站了多久？
太没礼貌了。

scripts.text:
The Rafflesia closed the book hastily.
You're curious what will happen next,
but you've been rude enough,
so you just give up.
scripts.translation:
大王花匆忙合上了书。
你很好奇接下来会发生什么，
但既然你已经够失礼了，
只好就此作罢。

scripts.text:
You leave the place quietly
in order not to disturb
the Rafflesia, who was lost in reading.
scripts.translation:
为了不打扰沉浸在阅读中的大王花，
你悄悄地离开了这里。

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
You want a banana?
scripts.translation:
[香蕉大王花]
你想要香蕉吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
Take it if you can.
If you are successful, you can have it for free.
scripts.translation:
[香蕉大王花]
如果你能拿到，就拿去吧。
如果你成功了，就可以免费拥有它。

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
Well, I was going to give it for free,
but if you don't want it, it's fine with me.
scripts.translation:
[香蕉大王花]
嗯，我本来打算免费给你的，
但如果你不想要，那也没关系。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
The Mora Inn is famous
for its unusual pieces of furniture.
Mushroom closets and apple dressers...
Aren't they so innovative?
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
穆拉旅馆以其独特的家具而闻名。
蘑菇衣柜和苹果梳妆台...
它们难道不很有创意吗？

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Sorry... maybe it's just me...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
抱歉...也许只是我觉得奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
The Rafflesia in Mora Village all look alike, so it's so confusing.
It's like looking at centuplets...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
穆拉村的大王花长得都差不多，所以很容易混淆。
就像在看多胞胎一样...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
However! If you look closely,
you'll find each of them has a personality.
To find it is one of the fun things
you can do in the village.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
不过！如果你仔细观察，
会发现它们每个人都有独特的个性。
发现这一点是你在村里可以做的有趣事情之一。

scripts.text:
[Wounded Raffle]
Ugghh... What was it
that was in the bath... Arrrghh...
To attack suddenly like that... Be careful...
Whatever it is in there, it's very aggressive.
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉弗尔]
呜...刚才在浴室里的是什么...
啊...
突然袭击...小心...
不管那是什么，它非常具有攻击性。

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The inn over there~
It should've been mine~
scripts.translation:
[活泼]
那边的旅馆~
本来应该是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The store over there~
It should've been mine as well~
scripts.translation:
[活泼]
那边的商店~
本来也应该是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The warehouse here~
and all the things in it~
All of those should've been mine~
All of those should've been mine~
scripts.translation:
[活泼]
这里的仓库~
还有里面的所有东西~
本来都应该是我的~
本来都应该是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
Ahhh... I'd like to make money...
scripts.translation:
[活泼]
啊...我想赚点钱...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
Oh... this duck...
scripts.translation:
[库奥里塔]
噢...这只鸭子...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
Its slender red beak...
and the blush on its cheeks...
and its wings, ready to take off
any moment...
scripts.translation:
[库奥里塔]
它细长的红喙...
还有脸颊上的红晕...
以及随时准备起飞的翅膀...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
I want to have it badly...
What would happen if I stole it?
scripts.translation:
[库奥里塔]
我真的很想要它...
如果我把它偷走会怎样？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
With a little token of appreciation, I will tell you a quote that will help you in your life.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
只要给我一点小费，我就送你一句能助你人生的名言。

scripts.text: Give him a token of appreciation.
scripts.translation: 给他一点小费

scripts.text: Can't you just tell me?
scripts.translation: 不能直接告诉我吗？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
You don't get something for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
天下没有免费的午餐。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
How much are you willing to give me?
You can pay me in the currencies listed below.
Enter the sum you're willing to pay. Enter 0 if you don't want to pay anything.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
你愿意付多少钱？
你可以用下面列出的货币支付。
请输入你愿意支付的金额。如果不愿支付，请输入0。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you don't want to hear a quote, eh?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
所以，你不想听名言，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
You can pay between ^FF0000100 and 1000000^000000.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
你可以支付 ^FF0000100 到 1000000^000000 之间的金额。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you think this is what my time is worth?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
所以，你觉得我的时间值这么多钱？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
The quote I'm going to tell you is...
Let's see... Wait a second.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
我要告诉你的名言是...
让我想想...稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
Okay! I think this is the one for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
好了！我觉得这句最适合你。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Nothing is more difficult,
and therefore more precious,
than to be able to decide.
- Napoleon Bonaparte -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
没有什么比做出决定更难，
因此也更珍贵。
- 拿破仑·波拿巴 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Sometimes we stare so long at a door that is closing,
that we see too late the one that is open.
- Alexander Graham Bell -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
有时我们盯着即将关闭的门太久，
以至于太晚才发现那扇敞开的门。
- 亚历山大·格拉汉姆·贝尔 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
If it's that painful, why do you keep doing it?
The answer's simple.
Because it makes my heart beat,
because it excites me.
My body might suffer, but I'm a lot happier
doing what I have always wanted to do.
- Biya Han -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
如果那么痛苦，你为什么还要继续？
答案很简单。
因为它让我的心跳动，
因为它让我兴奋。
我的身体可能会受苦，但我做着自己一直想做的事，
我感到非常快乐。
- 韩 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
You cannot persuade anybody
before you change yourself.
- Cheoljong Ko -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
在改变别人之前，
你必须先改变自己。
- 高宗 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Never regret what you have chosen.
- Miyoung Ko -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
不要后悔你所做出的选择。
- 高美英 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
A man is not finished when he is defeated.
He is finished when he quits.
- Richard Nixon -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
一个人只有在放弃的时候，
才算真正被击败。
- 理查德·尼克松 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Failure is instructive.
The person who really thinks
learns quite as much from his failures
as from his successes.
- John Dewey -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
失败具有教育意义。
真正善于思考的人，
从失败中学到的东西，
往往不亚于从成功中获得的。
- 约翰·杜威 -

[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
我们播种思想，收获行动；
我们播种行动，收获习惯；
我们播种习惯，收获性格；
我们播种性格，收获命运。
- 伊拉斯谟 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
There is no greater folly
in the world
than for a man to despair.
- Miguel de Cervantes -
scripts.translation:

- 奥修·拉杰尼什 -

{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
未曾哭泣的年轻人是野蛮人，
不愿大笑的老年人是傻瓜。
- 乔治·桑塔亚那 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
I do not have much patience
with a thing of beauty
that must be explained
to be understood.
If it does need additional interpretation
then I question
whether it has fulfilled its purpose.
- Charlie Chaplin -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
我对那些必须被解释才能被理解的美，
缺乏耐心。
如果它需要额外的解读，
我就怀疑它是否实现了它的目的。
- 查理·卓别林 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Life is a tragedy
when seen in close-up,
but a comedy
in long-shot.
- Charlie Chaplin -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
近距离看，生活是一场悲剧；
远距离看，生活是一场喜剧。
- 查理·卓别林 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
The clearest sign of wisdom is continued cheerfulness.
- Michel de Montaigne -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
智慧最明显的标志是持续的愉悦。
- 米歇尔·德·蒙田 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
The time you enjoyed wasting
was not wasted.
- John Lennon -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
你享受浪费的时间，
并没有被浪费。
- 约翰·列侬 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
True humor springs not more from the head than from the heart.
It is not contempt; its essence is love.
It issues not in laughter,
but in still smiles, which lie far deeper.
- Thomas Carlyle -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
真正的幽默，
不仅源于头脑，更源于心灵。
它不是蔑视，其本质是爱。
它不表现为大笑，
而是更深层的静默微笑。
- 托马斯·卡莱尔 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Through humor, you can soften
some of the worst blows
that life delivers.
And once you find laughter,
no matter how painful
your situation might be,
you can survive it.
- Bill Cosby -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
通过幽默，
你可以软化生活中最沉重的打击。
一旦你找到了笑声，
无论处境多么痛苦，
你都能生存下去。
- 比尔·科斯比 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
My great hope is to laugh
as much as I cry;
to get my work done
and try to love somebody
and have the courage
to accept the love in return.
- Maya Angelou -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
我最大的希望是，
能像哭泣一样多笑；
完成我的工作，
试着去爱某人，
并有勇气接受回报的爱。
- 玛雅·安吉洛 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
People take what they hear
differently.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
人们对自己听到的话，
理解各不相同。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
I wonder what you think
about what I've told you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
我想知道，
你对我刚才说的话怎么看。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you think that {0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
所以你认为{0}。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
... ... ... ...

[Raffle Philosopher]
I don't know. There is no one answer
to this question...
Hold onto your thought.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
我不知道。这个问题没有唯一的答案...
请坚守你的想法。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You... you dare play a game with me?
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
你...你竟敢跟我玩这种把戏？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
What...? Do you have proof?
Do you have proof?!!
scripts.translation:
[提问的旅行者]
什...什么？你有证据吗？
你有证据吗？！！

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
Look, stop it, just stop it!
I'm afraid it will turn into a big fight...
scripts.translation:
[劝架的旅行者]
喂，别吵了，快停下！
我怕这会演变成一场大斗殴...

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
Oh! Why don't we ask
that person there...?
scripts.translation:
[劝架的旅行者]
噢！我们要不问问那边那个人...？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
Oh, yes! That's a great idea.
Well~ Hello there~
You there, traveler!
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
噢，对！这是个好主意。
嘿~你好呀~
那边那位，旅行者！

scripts.text: They seem to be calling out to you.
scripts.translation: 他们似乎正在向你呼喊。

scripts.text: See what the matter is.
scripts.translation: 看看发生了什么事

scripts.text: I have nothing to do with it.
scripts.translation: 我与此事无关

scripts.text:
You went on your way
leaving the travelers behind you.
scripts.translation: 你离开了那些旅行者，继续前行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's happening here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
I'll tell you what.
Rose's mother had 10 sons.
The eldest son is called Roseone,
the second Rosetwo,
the third Rosethree...
the ninth Rosenine...
you get how it works, right?
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
我来告诉你。
萝丝的母亲有10个儿子。
大儿子叫Roseone，
二儿子叫Rosetwo，
三儿子叫Rosethree...
九儿子叫Rosenine...
你明白其中的规律了吧？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
Right, that's how it works.
So I asked what the youngest one would be called,
and when I told him the answer,
he got all upset and started cursing me.
scripts.translation:
[提问的旅行者]
对，就是这样的规律。
所以我问最小的那个叫什么，
当我告诉他答案时，
他非常生气，开始骂我。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You... you bastard!
Hey there, what do you think
the answer to the question is?
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
你...你这个混蛋！
喂，你觉得这个问题的答案是什么？

scripts.text: Roseten.
scripts.translation: Roseten

scripts.text: Rose.
scripts.translation: Rose

scripts.text: How would I know that?
scripts.translation: 我怎么知道？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The answer to the question is Roseten.
Why are you fighting over such a trivial matter?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个问题的答案是Roseten。
你们为什么要在这么琐碎的事情上争吵？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
See? Even this traveler says
Roseten is the answer.
How dare you try to play tricks on me?
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
看吧？连这位旅行者都说
Roseten是答案。
你竟敢耍我？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
You idiot... you don't have the slightest clue!
scripts.translation:
[提问的旅行者]
你这个笨蛋...你完全不懂！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The answer to the question is Rose.
You said Rose's mother had 10 sons.
So even if the other sons' names are
Roseone, Rosetwo, ... Rosenine,
the youngest one must be Rose,
or she wouldn't be called Rose's mother.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个问题的答案是Rose。
你说萝丝的母亲有10个儿子。
所以即使其他儿子的名字是
Roseone, Rosetwo, ... Rosenine，
最小的那个一定是Rose，
否则她就不会被称为萝丝的母亲。

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
That's exactly what I mean!
I can't hang around with him.
I guess we live in two different worlds.
scripts.translation:
[提问的旅行者]
我说的就是这个意思！
我没法和他这种人待在一起。
看来我们生活在两个不同的世界。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You bastard... What did you
get from this guy...?
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
你这个混蛋...你从这家伙那里
得到了什么好处...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have no idea.
Try to sort it out yourselves.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我完全不知道。
你们自己解决吧。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
You good-for-nothing bastard,
you're trying to leave this mess to me?
scripts.translation:
[劝架的旅行者]
你这个没用的混蛋，
你想把这烂摊子留给我？

scripts.text:
*thud*
You feel a sudden impact on the back of your head.
Your sight is going blurry.
scripts.translation:
*砰*
你感到后脑勺突然受到撞击。
你的视线开始模糊。

scripts.text: You feel somebody rummaging through your pockets before you pass out.
scripts.translation: 在你失去意识之前，你感觉到有人在翻你的口袋。

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Phew~ Phew~
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
呼~ 呼~

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snore...
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
呼噜...

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snort--
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
哼--

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snort--
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
哼--

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Moan...
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
呜...

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Phew phew pheeew~
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
呼~ 呼~ 呼~

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
兹 兹

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
兹 兹

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
兹 兹

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Oh~ looks like we have another adventurer.
Where are you from?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
哦~看来又来了一位冒险者。
您是从哪里来的？

scripts.text: Just save the game.
scripts.translation: 保存游戏

scripts.text: I'd like to get some rest.
scripts.translation: 我想休息一下

scripts.text: The place I used to live is called...
scripts.translation: 我以前住的地方叫...

scripts.text: How can I use the warehouse?
scripts.translation: 如何使用仓库？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Wow, what's the rush?
You've just come here, and you're already going someplace else?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
哇，这么急吗？
你刚来这里，就要去别的地方了？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
You know, haste makes waste. Tsk tsk.
Well, the game's been saved.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
俗话说，欲速则不达。啧，啧。
好了，游戏已经保存了。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
My my, I need some rest also.
The rate is 5000 zeny. Do you want a room?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
哎呀，我也需要休息一下。
房费是5000 Zeny。您想住一间房吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
The rate is 5000z.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
房费是5000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Make yourself at home.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
请自便。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
If you don't have the money, go soak yourself in the puddle in the center of the village.
It will warm you up.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
如果您没有钱，就去村中央的水坑里泡一泡吧。
那样会暖和一点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I come from a place called {1}.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我来自一个叫{1}的地方。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Oh, I think I've heard about the place before!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
哦，我想我以前听说过那个地方！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
I heard there's an old tower where horrible witches put Savages in a giant cauldron and cast evil spells on them, right?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
我听说那里有一座古老的塔，可怕的巫师们把野猪放进巨大的锅里，并对它们施放恶之魔力，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
What's worse is that whoever takes medicine made out of Savages will come back for more!
And he will wander around looking for the tower, and eventually turn into an enormous Savage!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
更糟糕的是，吃了用野猪做的药的人还会想要更多！
他们会四处游荡寻找那座塔，最终变成巨大的野猪！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
I heard that there are creeps there who won't get up at all even if it rains or snows, or their sweethearts or parents call them!
And that black clouds hover over them all the time, causing a storm!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
我听说那里有一些家伙，无论下雨下雪，或者他们的恋人或父母叫他们，他们都不会起床！
而且乌云总是悬停在他们的头顶，引发风暴！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
How terrible!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Search through the vegetable-shaped drawer to my right.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
请翻找我右边那个蔬菜形状的抽屉。

scripts.text: - You don't remember how to open the warehouse. -
scripts.translation: - 你不记得怎么打开仓库了。 -

scripts.text: - The figure 1 0 0 is written in small letters on the vegetable-shaped drawer. -
scripts.translation: - 蔬菜形状的抽屉上用很小的字写着数字 1 0 0。 -

scripts.text: Insert 100 zeny.
scripts.translation: 投入100 Zeny

scripts.text: Don't do anything.
scripts.translation: 什么都不做

scripts.text: - You don't seem to have 100 zeny with you. -
scripts.translation: - 你身上似乎没有100 Zeny。 -

scripts.text: - You gave up using the warehouse. -
scripts.translation: - 你放弃了使用仓库。 -
